summary:
Far signal is a 3D space exploration and mission simulation game built with Unity and C#. Set in 2168, the game puts players in the role of spacecraft commanders on an important mission: delivering essential equipment to a research base on the Moon. Working alongside a flight engineer, players face different challenges throughout their journey, from making engineering decisions and managing limited resources to preparing for landing, repairing equipment, exploring the lunar surface, finding safe routes, and restoring the base's power system.
Our main goal is to make learning about space engineering more exciting and enjoyable, especially for younger generations. We believe that learning becomes more meaningful when people can experience things for themselves rather than just reading about them. Through this game, players get to make their own decisions, solve real-world-inspired problems, and see how their choices affect the mission. We hope that this experience will spark curiosity about space, encourage creative thinking and problem-solving, and motivate young people to explore science, technology, and engineering. Most importantly, we want to show that learning about space can be an adventure, not just a lesson.
details:
Far signal is an interactive 3D space exploration and mission simulation game where players experience the challenges of completing a lunar delivery mission. Set in 2168, the game follows a spacecraft commander and a flight engineer as they travel to the Moon to deliver essential equipment to a lunar research base.

The game is divided into different mission stages, each presenting players with new tasks and challenges. Players must make important engineering decisions, manage available resources, prepare their spacecraft for landing, and deal with unexpected problems along the way. After reaching the Moon, they explore the lunar environment, repair damaged equipment, identify safe transportation routes, and work to restore the research base's power system. Their decisions influence how successfully they complete the mission.

One of the main benefits of our project is that it makes space engineering easier and more enjoyable to understand. Players do not simply receive information about spacecraft and lunar exploration; they actively participate in the process. By completing missions and solving problems, they can develop critical thinking, decision-making, and problem-solving skills while becoming more familiar with the challenges of real space missions.

Our intended impact is to encourage younger generations to become more interested in space exploration, science, and engineering. We want children and young people to see that engineering is not just about complicated equations or theories. It is also about creativity, teamwork, experimentation, and finding solutions to difficult problems. We hope the game can inspire players to learn more about space and perhaps consider careers in STEM fields.

We developed the project using Unity as our 3D game development platform and C# for programming the game's mechanics and interactions. The game is designed for PC (Windows), with a 3D environment that allows players to explore and interact with different parts of the mission.

What makes our project creative is the way it combines education with an interactive gaming experience. Instead of presenting space engineering as a traditional lesson, we turn it into a mission where players learn through experience. We also wanted to make the game engaging by giving players meaningful choices, different challenges, and the opportunity to experience both the technical and exploratory sides of a lunar mission.

During development, our team considered several important factors, including scientific accuracy, gameplay experience, accessibility for younger players, and the balance between educational content and entertainment. We wanted the challenges to be realistic enough to introduce actual engineering concepts while remaining understandable and enjoyable for players who may have little previous knowledge of space engineering.

Ultimately, Far signal is more than just a space exploration game. It is our attempt to make the world of space engineering accessible, exciting, and inspiring for the next generation of explorers and innovators.
